fun_list_spec <- function(spec,spec_c ="default"){
  list_ <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:length(spec)) {
    if (spec_c == c("Fissipedia")){
      split_ <- strsplit(spec[i]," ")[[1]]
      ID_ <- paste0(substr(split_[1], 1, 3),substr(split_[2],1,2))
    } else {
      split_ <- strsplit(spec[i]," ")[[1]]
      ID_ <- paste0(substr(split_[1], 1, 2),substr(split_[2],1,3))
    }
    list_[[spec[i]]] <- ID_
  }
  return(list_)
}

                      label = EEZ_land$Country,
                      labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, opacity = 1, textsize='15px')
          ) %>%

                                             "Exclusive Economic Zones"
                                             ),

                           options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = F)

  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    output$mymap <- renderLeaflet({
      leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 1, maxZoom = 18)) %>% 
        setView(lng = 10, lat = 0, zoom = 2) %>%
        addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldTopoMap") %>%
        addPolygons(data=Longhurst,
                    color = "red",
                    fillOpacity = 0,
                    group = "Longhurst Provinces",
                    weight=1,
                    smoothFactor = 0.5,
                    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 2,bringToFront = TRUE),
                    label = Longhurst$ProvDescr,
                    labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, opacity = 1, textsize='15px')

        ) %>%
        addPolygons(data=EEZ_land,
                    color = "#444444",
                    fillOpacity = 0,
                    group = "Exclusive Economic Zones",
                    weight=1,
                    smoothFactor = 0.5,
                    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 2,bringToFront = TRUE),
                    label = EEZ_land$Country,
                    labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, opacity = 1, textsize='15px')
        ) %>%
        addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("Longhurst Provinces",
                                           "Exclusive Economic Zones"
                                           ),
                         position = "topleft",
                         options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = F)
        ) %>%
        hideGroup("Longhurst Provinces") %>%
        hideGroup("Exclusive Economic Zones") 

    })
    
    ##################
    #options:
    ##################
    
    observe({
      
      #Species Uptade
      y <- input$taxa
      
      # Can use character(0) to remove all choices
      # if (is.null(y))
      #  y <- character(0)
      
      if (y=="Fissipedia")
        updateSelectInput(session, "species",
                          choices = li_fissi,
                          selected = tail(y, 1)
        )
      if (y=="Mysticeti")
        updateSelectInput(session, "species",
                          choices = li_mysti,
                          selected = tail(y, 1)
        )
      if (y=="Odontoceti")
        updateSelectInput(session, "species",
                          choices = li_odonto,
                          selected = tail(y, 1)
        )
      if (y=="Pinnipedia")
        updateSelectInput(session, "species",
                          choices = li_pinni,
                          selected = tail(y, 1)
        )
      if (y=="Sirenia")
        updateSelectInput(session, "species",
                          choices = li_siren,
                          selected = tail(y, 1)
        )
    })
    
    observe({
      #Threat attribute Uptade:
      x <- input$threat
      
      # Can use character(0) to remove all choices
      #  if (is.null(x))
      #    x <- character(0)
      
      if (x=='sum')
        updateSelectInput(session, "attribute",
                          choices = c("All" = "sum"),
                          selected = tail(x, 1))
      
      if (x=="BYCA")
        updateSelectInput(session, "attribute",
                          choices = list("All" = "BYCA", "By-catch" = "BYCA_1", "Shield-net" = "BYCA_2", "Ghost-net" = "BYCA_3", "Other interaction" = "BYCA_4"),
                          selected = tail(x, 1)
        )
      
      if (x=="DHAR")
        updateSelectInput(session, "attribute",
                          choices = c("All" = "DHAR", "Commercial" = "DHAR_1", "Subsistence" = "DHAR_2", "Control" = "DHAR_3", "Research" = "DHAR_4", "Alive Capture" = "DHAR_5"),
                          selected = tail(x, 1)
        )
      
      if (x=="POLL")
        updateSelectInput(session, "attribute",
                          choices = list("All" = "POLL", "Liquid wastes" = "POLL_1", "Solid wastes" = "POLL_2", "Noise" = "POLL_3", "Radioactive" = "POLL_4", "Thermal" = "POLL_5"),
                          selected = tail(x, 1)
        )
      
      if (x=="TRAF")
        updateSelectInput(session, "attribute",
                          choices = list("All" = "TRAF", "Boat without collision" = "TRAF_1", "Boat with collision" = "TRAF_2", "People" = "TRAF_3", "Aircraft" = "TRAF_4"),
                          selected = tail(x, 1)
        )
      
      if (x=="INFE")
        updateSelectInput(session, "attribute",
                          choices = list("All" = "INFE", "Infections" = "INFE_1", "Algea bloom" = "INFE_2", "Introduced Species" = "INFE_3"),
                          selected = tail(x, 1))
      
      if (x=="HABI")
        updateSelectInput(session, "attribute",
                          choices = list("All" = "HABI", "Food limitation" = "HABI_1", "Habitat Removal" = "HABI_2"),
                          selected = tail(x, 1)
        )
      
      if (x=="OCEA")
        updateSelectInput(session, "attribute",
                          choices = list("All" = "OCEA", "Storms" = "OCEA_1", "Temperature" = "OCEA_2", "ENSO" = "OCEA_3", "Ice cover" = "OCEA_4", "Geomagnetic field" = "OCEA_5"),
                          selected = tail(x, 1)
        )
    })
    
    #################
    #load threat map:
    #################
    
    
    observeEvent(input$Load, {
      output$mymap <- renderLeaflet({
        leaflet(options = leafletOptions(minZoom = 1, maxZoom = 18)) %>% 
          setView(lng = 10, lat = 0, zoom = 2) %>%
          addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldTopoMap") %>%
          ##add the selected rasterfile:
          addRasterImage(ras_two_sp[[paste0(isolate(input$species),"_",isolate(input$attribute))]], 
                         colors = colorFactor(c("grey", "orange", "darkred"), 
                                              values(ras_two_sp[[paste0(isolate(input$species),"_",isolate(input$attribute))]]),
                                              na.color = "transparent"),
                         opacity=0.6) %>%
          addLegend("topleft", 
                    pal = colorFactor(c("grey", "orange", "darkred"), 
                                      values(ras_two_sp[[paste0(isolate(input$species),"_",isolate(input$attribute))]]),
                                      na.color = "transparent"),
                    values = values(ras_two_sp[[paste0(isolate(input$species),"_",isolate(input$attribute))]]),
                    title = "Reported Threats") %>%
          addPolygons(data=Longhurst,
                      color = "red",
                      fillOpacity = 0,
                      group = "Longhurst Provinces",
                      weight=1,
                      smoothFactor = 0.5,
                      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 2,bringToFront = TRUE),
                      label = Longhurst$ProvDescr,
                      labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, opacity = 1, textsize='15px')

          ) %>%
          addPolygons(data=EEZ_land,
                      color = "#444444",
                      fillOpacity = 0,
                      group = "Exclusive Economic Zones",
                      weight=1,
                      smoothFactor = 0.5,
                      highlightOptions = highlightOptions(color = "white", weight = 2,bringToFront = TRUE),
                      label = EEZ_land$Country,
                      labelOptions = labelOptions(noHide = TRUE, textOnly = TRUE, opacity = 1, textsize='15px')
          ) %>%
          addLayersControl(overlayGroups = c("Longhurst Provinces",
                                             "Exclusive Economic Zones"
                                             ),
                           position = "topleft",
                           options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = F)
          ) %>%
           hideGroup("Longhurst Provinces") %>%
           hideGroup("Exclusive Economic Zones") #%>%
         # hideGroup("Ocean Basins")

      }) #renderLeaflet
    })
  }
